incentives.name: None: no data-center-specific state tax incentive found
incentives.what: South Dakota has no data center tax incentive in NCSL's 'Status of Data Center Tax Incentives, by State (2026)' table (adapted from Husch Blackwell's 50-state survey, last updated 2026-07-27; listed as N/A; table data: https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/TQYDf/5/dataset.csv). HB 1005 (2026), which would have created a sales and use tax exemption for data center operations, was deferred to the 41st legislative day (killed) in House State Affairs; NCSL says the South Dakota bill was defeated in committee.

laws_and_bills.name: Two data center bills, 2026 session (names not confirmed)
laws_and_bills.what: Two data center bills died in the South Dakota Senate in February 2026 (per related headline); a separate proposal would have required data centers to get permits from neighboring cities and counties

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1038 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Allows the Public Utilities Commission to assess actual costs to data centers that are customers of public utilities. Signed by the governor.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 135 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Protects residents from increased utility costs and utility shortages caused by data centers and clarifies authority to regulate data centers. Signed by the governor.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1005 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have provided a sales and use tax exemption for goods and services related to data center operations; deferred to the 41st legislative day by House State Affairs (9-3).

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1246 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have prohibited nondisclosure of certain agreements related to data centers; failed on the House floor.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1301 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have limited costs and risks of data center electricity use and imposed a moratorium; deferred to the 41st day in House State Affairs.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 127 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have limited nuisances caused by data centers; deferred to the 41st day in Senate State Affairs.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 232 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: One-year moratorium on construction or expansion of hyperscale data centers; tabled in Senate State Affairs.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 234 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have modified provisions on purchasing of goods and services related to data center operations; deferred to the 41st day.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 235 (2026)
laws_and_bills.what: Utility cost and shortage protections, regulatory authority, and data center purchasing provisions; deferred to the 41st day.

laws_and_bills.name: SB 177 (2025)
laws_and_bills.what: Would have provided a sales and use tax refund for goods and services related to data center operations; failed on the Senate floor (no reconsideration).
